description: Validates a proposed Binance spot order against public exchangeInfo/depth/ticker (LOT_SIZE, MIN_NOTIONAL, PRICE_FILTER, slippage, volume impact). Returns verdict pass/warn/block with per-check details. Calls AiphaBrain Lab's currently free POST https://api.aiphabrainlab.com/v1/pretrade-check. Never places orders, never pays. Not financial advice.
